question: Does an authoritative, Denver-specific seasonal fact exist that this page could use to answer a genuinely useful practical question it currently doesn't cover?
source: City and County of Denver — Department of Transportation and Infrastructure, LeafDrop program (denvergov.org); corroborated by Denver Gazette (2026-10-11) and Denverite coverage of the same program
evidence: Denver runs an official free LeafDrop leaf/pumpkin composting drop-off program every fall (2026 run: October 5 - November 25), at three named city locations (Cherry Creek Transfer Station, Denver Parks and Recreation at 3685 Havana St, Central Platte Campus).

The program requires leaves bagged in PAPER bags only (no plastic), with branches/other materials removed first — a specific, checkable logistical detail a homeowner would need to know before relying on it instead of a hauler.

Mile High's existing seasonal-cleanout page mentions "Fall brings yard waste — branches, leaves, and general cleanup" but does not mention this municipal program at all, despite it being directly relevant to exactly the fall yard-waste scenario the page already discusses.
limitations: Confirms the program exists and is relevant to the page's existing Fall section; does NOT establish how many of this page's actual visitors are unaware of LeafDrop already, nor that adding it would measurably change engagement — that would need real analytics/Search Console data this agent does not have access to.
recommendation: A genuine, specific, locally-grounded FAQ-worthy question exists and is currently unanswered on this page: e.g. "Can I use Denver's free LeafDrop program instead of hauling?" (branches/mixed debris and anything beyond paper-bagged leaves still need a hauler; LeafDrop is seasonal and location-limited). This is a real content opportunity — still requires a human to write accurate, current copy (verify dates/locations before publishing, since LeafDrop's dates are annual and this evidence is specific to the 2026 run) and remains PROPOSE_CHANGE, not an auto-write.
